question: What lack of devotion disqualifies a person in the context of this teaching?
premises: Absence of devotion to the kula is specified
Absence of devotion to the guru is specified
inference: One devoid of devotion to both kula and guru is unfit in this context.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of the locatives depends on the following verse.
plain_english: Indeed, in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
